items.title: Mac malware doesn't need a security flaw when users do the work
items.summary: Bitdefender's latest Mac threat report shows adware gaining ground as attackers increasingly use browser scams to trick users into bypassing Apple's security protections. MacBook Air M5 Bitdefender's September 2026 macOS Threat Landscape Report analyzes more than 1.5 billion security events collected between August 2025 and July 2026. Excluding web and document threats, adware rose from 22.6% of detections in the previous report to 34.4%. Trojans remained the largest category at 45.2%, down from 51.8%. Potentially unwanted apps also fell from 25.3% to 20.4%. The shift reflects the growing prominence of malicious ads , browser redirects, and deceptive software installers that trick users into compromising their Macs. items.title: Historic US ocean liner sinks near Florida to become world’s largest artificial reef
items.summary: SS United States, which set transatlantic speed record during maiden voyage in 1952, is sunk off coast of Destin The historic SS United States has reached the end of its journey at sea, sinking Wednesday off the coast of Destin, Florida, where it will begin a new life underwater as an artificial reef. The nearly 1,000ft American-made vessel, once the fastest ocean liner in the world, was launched in 1952 and made history by setting a transatlantic speed record during its maiden voyage. The ship carried thousands of passengers across the Atlantic over 17 years of operation before being retired in 1969. Continue reading...
